acceptanceCriteria: Control-run teardown failures get the same teardown-failed attribution as treatment runs.
A fixture with a failing control teardown is classified correctly; the test fails before the fix.
body: Residual from lane cce2-1022u (PR beamfall/corvint#1553, seal 751a2a15d). CCE-V0-048 attributes teardown failures in the treatment run, but a control (baseline) run whose teardown fails is still classified infrastructure_failed, which can hide a real defect in the discrimination verdict.
title: CCE still reads a control run whose teardown fails as infrastructure_failed
